name: My Pet Hunter
source:
6th episode in My pet Ragnarok series. 
Two incompatible people move in together, but there is a disturbing motion that draws them together...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]

《我的宠物仙境传说》系列的第六集。
两个不相容的人搬到了一起，但有一种令人不安的举动将他们吸引到了一起……
